reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Connecticut, focus_year 2021)
    Question: Does the law specify a minimum number of days a tenant can be late on rent
    before the landlord can file an eviction action for nonpayment?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic utilities (no external modules)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% integer_add(+A,+B,-C) is det.
integer_add(A, B, C) :-
    integer(A),
    integer(B),
    C is A + B.

% integer_ge(+A,+B) is det.
integer_ge(A, B) :-
    integer(A),
    integer(B),
    A >= B.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Provided context
scenario_state(connecticut).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The legal issue being asked about (abstract question, not a specific dispute)
scenario_issue(nonpayment_eviction_minimum_late_days).

% We assume a residential tenancy because the cited grace-period statute is for residential.
scenario_property_type(residential).

/* scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the encoded scenario is in place.
   It summarizes the question as a reusable logical condition. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(connecticut),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_issue(nonpayment_eviction_minimum_late_days),
    scenario_property_type(residential).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute applicability (simple year handling)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* statute_in_force(+State,+Citation,+Year) is det.
   Here we treat the provided "2020" statutes as in force for the 2021 focus year. */
statute_in_force(connecticut, ct_gen_stat_47a_15a, Year) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year >= 2020.
statute_in_force(connecticut, ct_gen_stat_47a_23, Year) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year >= 2020.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* CT Gen Stat  47a-15a (2020)
   - If rent is unpaid when due and tenant fails to pay within:
       * 9 days thereafter (general residential tenancies), OR
       * 4 days thereafter (one-week tenancy),
     the landlord may terminate the rental agreement per  47a-23 to 47a-23b.
*/

% statute_ct_47a_15a_grace_days(+TenancyType,-GraceDays) is det.
% TenancyType is either one_week or not_one_week.
statute_ct_47a_15a_grace_days(one_week, 4).
statute_ct_47a_15a_grace_days(not_one_week, 9).

/* CT Gen Stat  47a-23(a) (2020)
   - Summary process (eviction) is authorized when a rental agreement terminates, including for:
     (D) nonpayment of rent within the grace period provided for residential property in  47a-15a.
   CT Gen Stat  47a-23(a) also requires notice to quit at least three days before termination. */

% statute_ct_47a_23_notice_to_quit_min_days(-Days) is det.
statute_ct_47a_23_notice_to_quit_min_days(3).

/* Derived rule:
   For a residential nonpayment case, Connecticut law specifies a grace period (from 47a-15a),
   and requires a notice-to-quit lead time (from 47a-23). Together, they create a minimum
   number of days before an eviction case can be filed based on nonpayment.

   We model the earliest "trigger" to terminate for nonpayment as:
     trigger_after_grace = GraceDays + 1
   because the tenant must "fail to pay within N days thereafter" before termination can occur.

   And the earliest filing time is after the minimum notice-to-quit period is satisfied.
   We model:
     minimum_days_late_before_filing = trigger_after_grace + NoticeDays
*/

% minimum_days_late_before_landlord_may_file_summary_process(+State,+Year,+TenancyType,-MinDaysLate) is det.
minimum_days_late_before_landlord_may_file_summary_process(connecticut, Year, TenancyType, MinDaysLate) :-
    statute_in_force(connecticut, ct_gen_stat_47a_15a, Year),
    statute_in_force(connecticut, ct_gen_stat_47a_23, Year),
    statute_ct_47a_15a_grace_days(TenancyType, GraceDays),
    statute_ct_47a_23_notice_to_quit_min_days(NoticeDays),
    integer_add(GraceDays, 1, TriggerAfterGrace),
    integer_add(TriggerAfterGrace, NoticeDays, MinDaysLate).

/* law_specifies_minimum_late_days_before_nonpayment_eviction/2 is det.
   True if the law specifies an express numeric minimum (in days) relevant to
   nonpayment eviction timing (grace period and notice-to-quit). */
law_specifies_minimum_late_days_before_nonpayment_eviction(connecticut, Year) :-
    % Existence proof: there exists at least one computed minimum for a tenancy type.
    ( minimum_days_late_before_landlord_may_file_summary_process(connecticut, Year, not_one_week, Min1),
      integer_ge(Min1, 1)
    ; minimum_days_late_before_landlord_may_file_summary_process(connecticut, Year, one_week, Min2),
      integer_ge(Min2, 1)
    ),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer logic (must be derived, not hardcoded)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* housing_answer(-Result) is det.
   Result is yes or no. */
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    law_specifies_minimum_late_days_before_nonpayment_eviction(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law specify a minimum number of days a tenant can be late on rent before the landlord can file an eviction action for nonpayment?
